porur: Polygon covers the whole lake including the part south of the bridge. Total classified encroachment is small (4 patches, under 1 ha).
chembarambakkam: Large reservoir used as a control site. Its water extent swings in 2017-2019, probably with rainfall, which has not been checked against records.
ambattur: The 500 m ring was already about 91% built-up in 2025, so built-up growth there is small by construction.
puzhal: Large reservoir used as a control site. Built-up growth in its surrounding ring may be overstated because 2017 had fewer satellite scenes; this has not been verified.
pallikaranai: Marsh with channels and land strips narrower than a 10 m pixel. The water mask detected only 4 of 10 labelled water points here, so water-extent trends and the seasonal class are less reliable.
